# AMD FFX API headers

Source: GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK, commit 60f4ea81909200d8542eca14dccb2628b763a9a3.
Only the four public C headers needed by the D3D12 upscaling adapter are vendored.
Each file retains its AMD copyright and MIT license notice. No AMD or custom XMX binary is included here.
